failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 3: 'When was 2PM's "Take Off" single/music video released, and what is the exact date Jay Park officially left 2PM in 2010?' This is a natural-language compound question bundling two separate information needs (release date + departure date) in question form rather than structured keyword/entity format.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query asks 'When was 2PM's "Take Off" single/music video released' when hop 2 already retrieved the passage 'Take Off (2PM song) | "Take Off" is the debut Japanese single by South Korean boy band, 2PM. This single was released on May 18, 2011'. The query re-asks for information already provided in prior retrieval.
